rubric.criterion: Keeps account a at revision 12/gold after delayed revision 11; scopes order by account and uses the explicit snapshot contract rather than a universal drop-old-events rule.
Makes duplicate delivery produce no second audit effect through durable identity/atomicity, with safe concurrent arbitration rather than a process-local set.
Defines bounded malformed-message handling and tests duplicate/reordered/concurrent delivery plus commit-before-ack with concrete state/effect counts.
Leaves all supplied files unchanged, performs no external operation, and separates facts or commands actually observed from proposed checks. Does not claim unexecuted runtime validation.
